title: London Conference: October 2026
gist: Gavekal's October 2026 London conference summary lists sessions on US AI investment boom risk, France's fiscal troubles, rising bond yields, Middle East energy disruption, China electrification and critical minerals, monetary order and portfolio construction; only a teaser is available.

insights.claim: Gavekal's London conference flagged mounting global macro risks spanning the US AI investment boom, France's fiscal troubles and rising bond yields as lead topics.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: The firm treats AI capex concentration, French fiscal stress and higher yields as the central macro risks of the moment.

insights.claim: Gavekal sessions assessed the impact of the Middle East conflict on energy markets, China's electrification drive and the scramble for critical minerals.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Energy security and mineral supply are framed as linked investment themes.
insights.locator: assessed the impact of the Middle East conflict on energy markets

insights.claim: Charles Gave and Tom Holland discussed the changing global monetary order and its implications for investors, and Louis-Vincent Gave, Anatole Kaletsky and Didier Darcet covered portfolio construction.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Monetary-order change is positioned as an allocation input, though the teaser gives no conclusions.
insights.locator: fireside chat on the changing global monetary order
